---
title: "UC OSPO Network: Outputs"
---

Lessons, software, talks, papers, and press from the UC OSPO Network. Each section lists the newest work first.

Every entry on this page comes from one BibTeX file, [network-outputs.bib](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs/main/network-outputs.bib). Download it to cite these works in a paper or load them into a reference manager. Slides, handouts, and source for the talks are on the [talks and workshops page](index.html).

{{< include _outputs-generated.md >}}

## Add or correct an entry

Open an issue or a pull request on [network-docs](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs). Entries live in `network-outputs.bib`, and the page rebuilds when the change merges. The header of that file explains the fields.
